quizzes.title: Module 1 Quiz: Starting Out as a VA

questions.text: What is a Virtual Assistant (VA)?
choices: A remote professional who provides support to clients online

questions.text: Why do businesses hire VAs?
choices: To save time and money and access global talent
Because it is required by law
To replace their entire management team

questions.text: Which of these is NOT a common VA specialization?
What mindset trait do clients value most in a VA?
choices: Waiting to be told every single detail

questions.text: Why is a backup power or internet plan important for a VA?
choices: It is not important at all
To ensure reliability despite outages common in the Philippines
It is only needed for gamers

questions.text: Which tool is best known for simple visual task boards?
What is Canva primarily used for?
Which tool is commonly used to track hourly work for clients?
Which platform is part of Google Workspace?
Why should client files be organized in Drive or Dropbox?
choices: It looks nice but has no real benefit
For security, easy access, and professionalism
It is required by every government
To make files harder to find

questions.text: What does the 'Inbox Zero' approach help a VA do?
choices: Delete every email immediately without reading
Organize and act on emails efficiently

questions.text: What should a Social Media VA do with negative comments?
choices: Flag them to the client and respond professionally

questions.text: In customer support, what should you do with a complex issue you can't resolve?
choices: Guess an answer and hope it's right
Escalate it properly to the client
Close the ticket without a response

questions.text: What is a key rule in bookkeeping VA work?
choices: Mix personal and client funds for convenience
Never mix client and personal funds

questions.text: When doing research or content writing for a client, you should:
choices: Use any source, even unreliable ones
Use credible sources and match the client's tone

questions.text: Why is a portfolio valuable even without paid job experience?
choices: It proves your skills and builds credibility
It replaces the need for any skills

questions.text: What is a 'mock project'?
choices: A sample project created to demonstrate your skills

questions.text: How should mock projects be labeled?
choices: They should not be labeled at all

questions.text: How many strong samples are recommended over ten weak ones?
What are good free tools for building a simple portfolio page?
What should a VA resume bullet point focus on?
choices: Results and value delivered, with numbers when possible

questions.text: Which platforms are commonly used by Filipino VAs to find work?
choices: None, VAs cannot find jobs online

questions.text: What makes a strong proposal or cover letter?
choices: A generic copy-paste message sent to everyone
Personalization referencing the specific job post

questions.text: What should you do after a client interview?
choices: Send a short, genuine thank-you message
Ask for payment before being hired

questions.text: A good freelance profile headline should be:
choices: Specific and benefit-driven for your ideal client
Written in a language the client doesn't understand

quizzes.title: Module 6 Quiz: Landing Your First Client

questions.text: What should you NEVER do when applying for VA jobs?
choices: Pay money to apply for a job

questions.text: Which is a common VA pricing model?
choices: Charging only in a foreign currency you don't understand

questions.text: How should you communicate your rate to a client?
choices: Clearly and confidently, with the value explained
Never mention your rate at all

questions.text: What is a good first step when onboarding a new client?
choices: Guess what they want without asking
Clarify tasks, tools, and expectations, then put it in writing
Avoid all communication in week one

questions.text: What helps build a long-term VA career?
choices: Asking for testimonials and continuously learning
